notes.title: Uncensored 18+ content now will be available in base game!
notes.notes:
Due to steam policy, Re: Destiny has been classified as Adult Only game, therefore we have moved the uncensored 18+ content to base game as well.
DLC players do not need to be concerned about this change, we will still update the game on both sides. They will have the same content though.
_______________________

In Addition, we will add more animation scenes to the games. Here is a sneak peek of them. Enjoy!
